name: @correctiv/desktop
description: EXPERIMENTAL desktop host for the CORRECTIV app — GTK4/Adwaita via gjsify's React-Native layer. A feasibility demonstration, not a release target.

scripts.build: npm run fonts && npm run build:gjs
scripts.build:gjs: gjsify build src/entry.tsx --app gjs --outfile dist/app.gjs.mjs --exclude-globals navigator
scripts.build:all: npm run build:gjs && npm run build:node
scripts.audio-probe: gjsify build src/debug/audio-probe.ts --app gjs --outfile dist/audio-probe.gjs.mjs --exclude-globals navigator && node scripts/start.mjs --bundle dist/audio-probe.gjs.mjs
scripts.font-probe: gjsify build src/debug/font-probe.ts --app node --outfile dist/font-probe.node.mjs --exclude-globals navigator && node scripts/start.mjs --bundle dist/font-probe.node.mjs --host node
scripts.gst-probe: gjsify build src/debug/gst-probe.ts --app node --outfile dist/gst-probe.node.mjs --exclude-globals navigator && node scripts/start.mjs --bundle dist/gst-probe.node.mjs --host node

ship.summary: The CORRECTIV community app, on the desktop
ship.description: An EXPERIMENTAL desktop host for the CORRECTIV app, built to answer one question with evidence: can this app grow a desktop target without its core moving. It renders the same React Native screens onto GTK4 and Adwaita. Not a release target.
